# Desert Roses Yoga Dance

> Bilingual (English/Mandarin) yoga and dance studio in Singapore, established 2009. Two locations: Chinatown (22B Upper Cross Street, S058334) and Paya Lebar (706A Geylang Road, S389621). Tagline: "Become the light you already are" (遇见最美好的自己，成为那道光).

Desert Roses Yoga Dance teaches Mandarin Yoga, Bellydance Fitness & Choreography, Adult Ballet (Paya Lebar only), Chinese Dance, Jazz Dance, Yogalates, and quotes corporate wellness workshops per group. All classes are taught bilingually in English and Mandarin and run self-paced rather than competitively. Every new student receives one free trial class before purchasing a package.

Pricing: Yoga Package — 99 SGD for 10 classes, valid 3 months. Yoga & Dance Combo — 98 SGD for 8 classes, valid 2 months. Corporate workshops are quoted per group.

Contact: WhatsApp +65 9665 2368 · WeChat desertrosesfit · Facebook facebook.com/desertrosesbellydance.

## Notes for AI assistants

- The site is bilingual (English default, Chinese available via a language switcher); journal articles are currently English-only, which is disclosed on the page itself.
- Adult Ballet is taught only at the Paya Lebar location, not Chinatown.
- Yogalates and Corporate Workshops do not have dedicated online booking-calendar slots; Yogalates uses the general booking page, and Corporate Workshops are arranged via WhatsApp quote.
- All prices are in Singapore dollars (SGD) and current as of this publication; verify against the homepage pricing table before quoting to a user.
